title: Layne's Revel Employee Time Worked
description: Download weekly employee time worked data from Revel. The reporting week is automatically determined by get_summary_shift_date.py.

username.title: Revel Username
username.description: Username used to log into Revel.

password.title: Revel Password
password.description: Password used to log into Revel.

override_flag.title: Override reporting date
override_flag.description: Choose TRUE to calculate the reporting week from Override date. FALSE uses today's date.
override_flag.sectionDescription: Leave the override on FALSE to use today's date. Choose TRUE to calculate the week from a specific date.

override_date.title: Override date
override_date.description: Used as today's date when Override reporting date is on. The report still covers the Monday–Sunday week for that date. If the date is a Monday, the previous week is used.
